name: Grand Tunis
author: m0etez
description:
Greater Tunis, Tunisia: the governorates of Tunis, Ariana, Ben Arous and La Manouba, from Raoued, Gammarth and La Marsa to Hammam-Lif and Borj Cédria, including the Gulf of Tunis and the Lake of Tunis.

- ~1.31M modelled commuters, 4,066 demand points, 22,778 groups
- Residents from WorldPop 2020 rescaled to the 2024 census (INS) per governorate
- Tunis–Carthage airport, 10 university hubs, the Medina souks, major malls, beaches, Carthage, Sidi Bou Saïd, Bardo museum, Radès stadium, La Goulette ferry terminal
- Labels in French
- Peak-hour driving times (OSRM ×1.6)
